reserveReview.rationale: Exhibit B of the KPMG-examined USDP report at August 31, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time discloses USD $22,220,905 cash, $6,969,000 Treasury-collateralized reverse repos, no government money-market funds or direct Treasury obligations, and total redemption assets $29,189,905. Independently reproduced division by that disclosed total and rounding to two decimal places yields 76.13% cash and 23.87% repo. The observed repo matures September 1; this does not establish a standing three-day maximum, which is removed. Repo collateral may not be sold or repledged. Asset categories and existing liquidity labels are unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of the USDP Redemption Assets Report, Exhibit B as of August 31, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time; USD amounts divided by disclosed USD total
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report identifies the complete asset-type composition. Individual commercial-bank and broker-dealer counterparties are anonymized, but no reserve asset class is unclassified.
